items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: So, when we got on the bandstand and Thomas start paying off, he told wash, now you don't get a nickel.

ctx.x: Yeah. So, well, finally, he went up and he wrote me, asked me if I wanted to come up. But I told him, no, at that time I was playing by head and that fella's up there, it would make me shame about him when I tell him. So I told him, no, I didn't want to come up there. So, that's where I started playing with Thomas. Well, I played with Thomas about, oh, a couple of years I fooled around with Thomas. And I just got tired and give it up altogether. Just stop, stop playing. When did you stop? What year would that be?…
Well, you must have played with somebody after you played with Thomas, huh? Who, with Thomas?
